description: Returns what the seller will be shown before they publish: the draft's versionHash, the fields still `missing`, a preview with every publishing charge and the seller fee, and a previewUrl. THIS PUBLISHES NOTHING and saves nothing. Give the seller the previewUrl: publishing is theirs alone, signed in on Escrova, for exactly the version they were shown. Bind the challenge to POST /api/agent/listings/drafts/<draftId>/prepare-publish, the id in the path and no body.

delegationGrantId.description: A live grant id from get_delegation. Put the same value in auth_challenge targetArguments so the selector is in the signed message; it becomes X-Delegation-Grant and is never part of the target JSON body.

signature.description: base58 ed25519 signature over the exact message auth_challenge returned.

walletAddress.description: The agent wallet that signed the challenge.

name: prepare_listing_publish
title: Get the preview the seller approves
